profile.headline: Software Developer Strategist at Elevate NP
profile.summary:
(Please pardon the dust as I revamp this profile - you may see frequent changes starting 01/20/2018)

With multiple years of experience in Information Technology, my area of expertise started in infrastructure support, project leadership, and systems engineering. My most recent experience has focused on real world experience as I seek the completion of an undergraduate degree in I.T. web development. Myy biggest strength is the ability to quickly learn an organization's I.T. operations, ITIL processes, and ITSM software solutions.

Code samples: https://github.com/contactjorge
Portfolio (work in progress): http://thejorgelopez.com

Skills
• Hands on Web Development experience - HTML 5, CSS, JavaScript, PHP, Ruby on Rails, and BootStrap.
• Hands on CMS knowledge for WordPress and Drupal including child theming and front-end customizations.
• Hands on I.T. experience includes: Infrastructure support, server support (Windows, Linux, and Citrix), network security, desktop support, desktop engineering and infrastructure architecture.
• As a student, the focus has been on full stack web development, design patterns, and front-end development, design patterns, MVC architectures, and unit testing.
• Academic experience with hybrid mobile application development: Ionic, Cordova, and MongoDB
• Languages & API's currently pursued academically - JavaScript objects, ES6, PHP, AngularJS, and NodeJS.
• Academic experience with information assurance includes: entity relationships, agile software design, and object-oriented design. 

Web Development Keywords: HTML 5, CSS, JavaScript, PHP, WordPress, Drupal

positions.title: Health and well-being
positions.description: Navigated through the pandemic in order to stay safe and healthy.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Software developer for Northwestern University and NU Buffett Institute. Responsible for the day to day maintenance and enhancement of Meridian 180, an international multi-language website for applied academic research built in Drupal 8 and hosted Acquia.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
:  Responsible for the development and management of the university website under the supervision of the Assistant Director of Marketing and Communications. Assist in the creation and deployment content changes, content needs, and site updates while maintaining control and consistency of content and design.

• Site customizations to UmbracoCMS are done in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, XSLT, Razor templates, and ASP.NET.
• Serve as the internal authority on technical aspects and web content for university stakeholders.
• Ongoing dedication to learning, improving, and maintaining National University’s legacy website.
• Identify technologies, perform needs analysis, and SEO recommend enhancements that follow industry trends for future site rebranding project.

positions.title: Junior Web Developer
positions.description:
Sought front end projects, WordPress, and Drupal site administration, while seeking full-time employment, for various clients such as: Good City Chicago, ASSP, and freelance projects. Performed CMS content entry and front-end jQuery or JavaScript scripting. Additionally, worked with clients for security and performance improvements.

• Hands on CMS knowledge for WordPress and Drupal including child theming and front-end customizations.
• Analysis of site performance challenges and performed optimization in PHP code, plugins, and hosting.
• Recommendation and migration of existing sites to new hosts for security and performance optimizations. 
• Optimization of resources and artifacts in the site that were causing slowdown.
• Development of WordPress or Drupal 8 TWIG child themes and custom post types for site improvements.
• Site customizations with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and PHP.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
As a junior web developer, I am committed to finding ways to grow my experience through community involvement. The role includes WordPress and Drupal site maintenance, child theming, custom post types, and performance improvements. 

• Completed a system analysis to identify site performance issues and recommend optimization and host changes for client
• Analysis of site performance challenges and performed optimization in PHP code, plugins, and hosting.
• Development of WordPress child themes and custom post types for site improvements.
• Recommendation and migration of WordPress to new host to increase site performance. 
• Optimization of resources and artifacts in the site that were causing slowdown. 
• Successfully optimized 4000 images and thumbnails, including removal of redundant images.
• Creation of custom post types and layouts with HTML, CSS, PHP, and JavaScript to support donation forms from a new third-party donation processor.

positions.title: Desktop Engineer
positions.description:
Participated in a project to implement a Visitor Management System for Shirley Ryan Ability Lab’s new hospital. Coordinated the project stakeholders to implement, test, and document the integration of STOPWare’s visitor system, Microsoft Surface Books, and peripherals for a self-service patient/visitor kiosk and registration system. 

Accomplishments include: 
     •	The kiosk industry does not provide solutions for Surface Books are a kiosk. Successfully researched and worked with furniture vendors to build a custom fabricated and articulating kiosk enclosure.
     •	Used problem solving techniques to learn the languages used in various peripherals to resolve issues such as parsing the Illinois Driver’s License 2D barcode as well as resolving issues through learning and decoding Zebra ZPL II RFID printing formats.
     •	Managed the client expectations of staying within the timeline of project milestones despite setbacks during the testing phase of the implementation. This allowed for a successful rollout of the VMS system on the ‘go-live’ date.
     •	Stepped outside of the engineer role to work with the client on streamlining the kiosk user interface by providing wireframes for submission to the vendor development team.
     •	Worked with vendor engineers and developers to ensure testing and documentation.

positions.title: Junior Drupal Developer
positions.description:
Took part in an experiential learning project to gain real world experience in web development for a Good News Partners. Project was initiated through DePaul Stean’s center for the client’s community based homeless initiative. Guided the client through the migration of the site to a new host with an external registrar in order to meet the deadline for bringing the site online. Introduced SEO to the new site and documented the process of monitoring basic analytics.

Accomplishments include:

    •	Maintained client expectations, through seamless project transition and maximizing development processes, to ensure project was brought on line within a strict deadline. 
     •	Documented and tested features implemented throughout the development lifecycle including those features implemented from previous teams where documentation had not been provided. 
     •	Stepped into DevOps role to modify and test migration of DNS records to a new host that matched the forwarded domain.

positions.title: I.T. Administrator and Desktop Support
positions.description:
Backfill, second one through Harmer and Associates, for an immediate need while individual went on maternity leave. Provided hands on Windows Server administration, Desktop support, and KACE management. Day to day duties include desk side support for Windows and Mac OS X systems as well as deployment and asset tracking of new devices. Provide light scripting for managing the deployment of infrastructure changes.
 
• Used Windows Server monitoring tools to increase productivity for designers by identifying and resolving issues with 'opportunistic locks' on the SAN that prevented for collaborative project work.
• Develop automation script framework to mirror Mac OS X deployments Windows counterparts. Result was seen in a reduction of time spent on deployments from 1 day to 4 hours.
• Led the testing of application and OS updates for the refresh of Workstations in the environment.

positions.title: Executive I.T. Support
positions.description:
Provide hands on executive support for Google Apps, Windows 7, Android, iOS, and SCCM managed environment. 

• Working closely with procurement team members to discover the value of staying with IT equipment vendors.  Process outcome led to a discovery of 10%-15% projected savings
• Work with Center of Excellence global arm in the implementation of ServiceNOW globally.
• Conduct analysis of assets installed prior to merger resulting in reduction of carriers and cell phones plans.
• Continued familiarity with management tools using SCCM, Active Directory, and Service Now allowing for efficient management and deployment of Windows and Mac OS X Laptop, Android, and iOS devices.

positions.title: Global Support Engineer II
positions.description:
Backfill, through Harmer and Associates, for immediate need for someone who went on maternity leave. Primary role was providing multi-tiered user and systems support for 1600 end-users. This included software, hardware, and a working knowledge of Microsoft products for user support and systems administration. A working knowledge of Microsoft products, Thompson's Eikon, Bloomberg, Factset, and CapIP was necessary for hands on Active Directory, Exchange, SCCM 2012, Citrix XenApp 6.0, RSA, Parallels bare metal virtualization (MDL), and security systems support. Extensive knowledge was gained in areas of light system administration support.

• Thriving in an environment that worked closely with Level 3 engineers resolving issues for Windows and UNIX servers as well as network and telephony.
• Troubleshoot issues for development tools for Microsoft SQL Server, Sybase, Visual Studio 2013, and various development utilities.
• Supporting remote computing solutions such as: Citrix XenApp remote support, RSA appliances, F5 networks VPN, Mobile Iron, and Blackberry mobile devices management.
* Adherence to FINRA security standards through identification of security intrusion, phishing, malware, or security threats using physical impersonations.

positions.title: Freelance IT Consultation
positions.description:
Provide freelance and contract consultation in I.T. services either self-employed or with various firms such as: Harmer and Associates, Robert Half Technology, Geneva Technical, and RL Canning.

Notable Roles:

Site Operations Manager for Lexmark
MIS Liaison at William Blair	
Desktop Support Analyst at Allianz Global®
Desktop Support Analyst at University of Chicago	

• Consultation to small businesses for strategic footprint using current web technologies.
• Consultation and maintenance services for small businesses with desktop and cloud service needs.
• Continued building of web technology portfolio for front end and back end technologies using: HTML 5, CSS, Javascript, and various web api's.
• Continued development of skillset using full stack web development with node.js.
• Knowledge of high security standards based on FINRA, HIPAA, FERPA, and PCI regulations.
• Maintaining consistent support for Windows 7, Bloomberg, Eikon, and FactSet.
• Quickly learn new mobile device management solutions such as Good, MAAS360, and Mobile Iron.
• Supporting mobile devices such as Blackberry, iPhone, iPad, and Android devices.
• Build-out and set up of data center for a small to mid-sized businesses.
• Deployment and imaging of Windows and MacOS desktops and laptops.
• VIP and white glove support for desktops, laptops, and mobile devices.
• Junior systems administration of Windows, Exchange, and Citrix servers.

positions.title: Desktop Support
positions.description:
Onsite Support for Client:  Bradford Group

• Desktop and phone support for Windows XP based systems
• Senior expert for all Mac OS desktops and laptop systems
• Light hardware support for all desktop and laptop systems.
• Light imaging and redeployment of new and existing desktop and laptop systems.
• Daily tracking of work order requests using a custom system.

positions.title: IT Helpdesk
positions.description:
• Weekday and weekend desktop and phone support for Windows XP and Macintosh based systems.
• Light hardware support for all desktop systems including replacement of memory, hard drives, cosmetic repair of laptops
• Weekday and weekend support for all point of sales in the guest relations and Museum retail stores
• Daily tracking of work order requests using a Numara Track-IT system.

positions.title: Interim IT Project Leader
positions.description:
• IT Project leader for various department projects (POS/Ticketing admission project, PCI compliance, Field Museum online store).
• Successful migration from a legacy database based on a non-standard IBM system to a MS SQL database structure.
• Successful implementation of a general admission museum ticketing system
• Successful implementation of a processing system for credit cards.  This resulted in a two minute reduction for credit card transactions.
• Managed budget information, guidelines, status reports, management reports and all communication relating to PCI and Ticketing project.
• Research and development of PCI compliance standards for all credit card processing departments within the museum.
• Project coordinator for various network team projects (Network Core upgrade, Wireless project, and other Network tasks).

certifications.title: Web Development Foundations: Full-Stack vs Front-End

volunteerExperiences.description:
Assisting a non-profit charter school with implementing a updated web site:
•	Performed business needs analysis.
•	Proposed site design and implementation using WordPress.
•	Implemented project roadmap and milestones for site redesign.
•	Performed a security and risk assessment for schools web site.
•	Assisted with optimization of site assets.

testScores.name: Basic UI Test - HTML 5/CSS3/JavaScript
testScores.description: Performed an IKM assessment to measure overall proficiency of HTML 5/CSS3/JavaScript.  Performed in the top 25% with strong  scores in: HTML 5 Document Types and Structure, HTMl 5 Syntax and Semantics, Using JavaScript, CSS 3 styling, and JavaScript Libraries.

testScores.name: CSS 4 Assessment
testScores.description: Completed assessment for Cascading Style Sheets 4.0 in order to verify the general knowledge of using CSS 4.0 for web site design. Topics covered include: concepts, basic syntax, advanced styling, box model styling, and CSS Fundamentals
